name: Valle de Losa (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Losa (a castle, a chalice, a tree and a tower, with flags).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Losa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Losa arms — castle, chalice, tree and tower
